messages:
ivy: Pushed a tiny PR to replace the old heatmap example with a Rust + TS duo that shows KV-cache cost lines and TraceKey usage. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6011

sam: Thanks. Can you also update the dashboard query id in heatmap.md? The example uses an older query that doesn't return kv metrics.

ivy: Good catch. I updated the query to use @window_end macro and swapped the query id. Also added a 1-line TS snippet showing traceKey.

ci-bot: link-check: 1 redirect detected -> telemetry-setup.md. Marked as warning on PR #6011.

rei: Add a prereq note: KV-cache attribution requires runtime prefix-caching enabled. Otherwise cost will show only generation. Small footnote saves confusion.

ivy: Added the footnote and a QA step in the PR description: "open sample org -> run heatmap for 30s -> confirm separate KV-cache cost line". infra-bot: preview built: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/6011

sam: LGTM pending CI green. I'll approve after nit about hyphenating "KV-cache".

ivy: Fixed hyphen. Thanks all, will merge on green and ping #docs. :tada:
